title: K9 Veterans Day - Military working dog Tomas retires
description: U.S. Army Spc. Bryant Olartes, a military working dog handler assigned to the 520th Military Police Detachment (Military Working Dog), 8th Military Police Brigade, 8th Theater Sustainment Command, shares his thoughts about military working dog Tomas and the MWD's upcoming retirement on Schofield Barracks, Hawaii, Mar. 10, 2025. After two and half years together, Olartes and Tomas have built a special bond, but, as Tomas retires, the duo splits so the Tomas can finally relax with a happy family. (U.S. Army video by Sgt. Nickson Schenk; music - 190117-chill/japan/calm/simple/nostalgic by WELC0MEИ0 / HomeMadeGarbage SoundTracks)
